description: This class provides static methods to detect SOCKS4 and SOCKS5 protocol messages within a ByteBuf, used for proxy detection in network communication.

classes.name: SocksDetector
classes.description: Utility class for detecting SOCKS4 and SOCKS5 protocol messages in ByteBuf streams.

methods.name: isSocks4
methods.description: Detects if the given ByteBuf contains a SOCKS4 request.

methods.name: consumeFields
methods.description: Consumes SOCKS4 request fields from ByteBuf, checking for SOCKS4a specific hostname indicator.

methods.name: consumeUsername
methods.description: Consumes the username string from ByteBuf, up to 256 characters or until a null byte.

methods.name: consumeHostname
methods.description: Consumes the hostname string from ByteBuf, up to 256 characters or until a null byte.

methods.name: isSocks5
methods.description: Detects if the given ByteBuf contains a SOCKS5 request with supported authentication methods.
